hook.name: CDHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for CoinDAT (CD) token ETH pools that implements time-decaying swap fees starting at 99% and decreasing to 7% over ~92 minutes. After each swap, it collects fees via afterSwapReturnsDelta and distributes them to the CD token accumulation contract (72%), protocol treasury (14%), and token deployer (14%).
